probes.name: Studio horizon
probes.thesis: A useful open tools plane flows into a horizontal studio horizon, clear native route groups, and a continuous personalized illustrated ending. The art is the terminal atmosphere rather than a framed card.
probes.layout: Restrained two-column AI question console / open product-updates form → full-width horizontal project strip → grouped native navigation and legal → native wordmark → personalized terminal panorama. All controls/legal precede the image in DOM and visually. Mobile stacks the tools, preserves a keyboard-scrollable project strip and two-column native groups; the app/read variant reduces type, textarea and ending height.
probes.typography: {'ph': 'Atlas serif wordmark and moderate editorial tool headings, system body/control text', 'codevetter': 'Native system sans, measured tracking, mono reserved for small context labels'}

probes.name: Studio ribbon
probes.thesis: A continuous editorial footer gives discovery its own horizontal strip, exposes the AI question and email capture, and dissolves the closing identity into a product-specific scene.
probes.layout: Next action; horizontal studio rail; two-column AI context/composer; horizontal visible capture; grouped resource/support routes; legal and oversized wordmark bleeding into terminal panorama. Quiet browser variant suppresses marketing CTA and reduces scene/name density.
probes.typography: Atlas native Georgia with forest ink/paper; CodeVetter native system sans and amber. Navigation14px and prose14–15px, consent12px; no code/terminal text styling.

probes.name: Immersive studio
probes.thesis: A continuous product-colored footer turns the studio and service infrastructure into readable editorial content. Discovery begins as a horizontal strip; native identity and structured routes lead into an exposed question console and an always-open opt-in row. A large terminal panorama dissolves upward into the same plane, without a framed artwork card.
probes.layout: Discovery strip → native wordmark + three route groups → visible AI console + direct feedback → always-open email row → native/legal → literal last art figure. Legal lives in the shaded upper bleed region; no controls overlay the lower busy illustration. App scales wordmark/console/image and omits repeated primary download/demo CTA.
probes.typography: Atlas Georgia large wordmark, native paper/forest/coral; CodeVetter true-black, native system sans and evidence-white wordmark, amber action/focus. UI prose and inputs retain system body type.

ownerEvidence.quote: The footer should ideally bleed into the image. Something like 3, but better. Where is the AI console in this? Waitlist should have an always-open text field. I like the strip-based approach to discover projects.

customReplacement.reason: Existing native inputs/buttons/links, source-owned provider URL builders/logos and horizontal discovery patterns; no new dependency/runtime or backend.

contract.purpose: Merge product CTA, visible AI console, visible opt-in email, studio strip and coherent native routes into a continuous footer ending in personalized artwork.
contract.canonicalPurpose: A backend-free browser composition preserves product identity and existing service/component ownership.
contract.audience: Visitors and browser users of applicable Fleet products.
contract.job: Choose a next product action, edit a question for an existing assistant, opt into updates or find a studio/support route.
contract.thesis: Open useful controls and a horizontal studio rail flow through a native editorial footer into a terminal illustration.
contract.system: Three different arrangements and text/composer treatments share native typography, product color roles and conceptual mechanism-specific art.
contract.signature: A smooth continuous footer/art transition with a real editable external AI handoff and immediately visible email.
contract.risk: Quiet upper artwork can extend behind the wordmark/legal; no busy focal objects behind controls. More visible controls increase mobile length.
contract.qualityBar: No hidden email/AI surface, no fake chat or launch-waitlist claim, clean route groups and strip, no overflow, explicit unchecked consent, personalized illustration last in DOM and clear rendered gradient.
